what_this_is: a DESIGN calculation, not a measurement of any datastream: the spread of the held-out C-index over independent cohorts of the manifest's size, resampled from the cached real cohort
source_cohort: cached GDC clinical export (TCGA-GBM), overall survival
manifest_source: CFB-GBM, The Cancer Imaging Archive (Centre Francois Baclesse), DOI 10.7937/v9pn-2f72 -- Data Citation Required

notes: design calculation: this bounds what a cohort of this size could show, it does not measure any stream, covariate, or treatment effect

load_notes: 595 patients with a usable os endpoint
1 patient(s) recorded Dead with no days_to_death: censored at last contact because there is no event time
1 dropped: no usable time or endpoint
what_this_cannot_show: It does not measure delta-volume, registration error, or scanner comparability: the CFB-GBM images are not downloaded.
It says nothing about progression-free survival; the cached cohort is scored on overall survival, which is the endpoint the availability manifest does not carry at all.
A resolved floor is a permission to look, not evidence that any stream carries a signal.
